content: For word similarity evaluations, we use the WordSim-353 Similarity (WS-Sim) and Relatedness (WS-Rel) BIBREF28 and SimLex-999 (SimLex) BIBREF29 datasets, and the Rare Word (RW) BIBREF20 dataset to verify if subword information improves rare word representation. Relationships are measured using the Google semantic (GSem) and syntactic (GSyn) analogies BIBREF2 and the Microsoft syntactic analogies (MSR) dataset BIBREF30 .
